name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-hermes
description: Cockpit for your Hermes Agent. See what your agent is doing, chat with it, manage its skills, and govern every memory it writes into your vaults — keep, move or reject, with full provenance. Hermes roams the world; you govern what it remembers.

descriptionI18n.en: Cockpit for your Hermes Agent. See what your agent is doing, chat with it, manage its skills, and govern every memory it writes into your vaults — keep, move or reject, with full provenance.
descriptionI18n.fr: Cockpit pour votre agent Hermes. Voyez ce que fait votre agent, discutez avec lui, gérez ses skills, et gouvernez chaque souvenir qu'il écrit dans vos coffres — garder, déplacer ou rejeter, avec provenance complète.
descriptionI18n.es: Cabina de control para tu agente Hermes. Observa lo que hace tu agente, chatea con él, gestiona sus skills y gobierna cada recuerdo que escribe en tus cofres — conservar, mover o rechazar, con procedencia completa.

agentActions.summary: Where the Hermes agent stands: installed or not, whether its gateway is up, starting or down, since when, and the tab on the person's screen.
agentActions.details: gateway is null when it is not probed (no install, or the api server is off). A gateway that just started takes 10-20 s to be up.

agentActions.summary: The tasks given to Hermes, newest first: what was asked, its status, how long since its last sign of life, what it answered, and an approval waiting for the person.
agentActions.details: waitsForThePerson is answered by the person on their screen, never by an agent. silentSeconds is a fact; a task is never said to be working.

agentActions.summary: Show one tab of the cockpit on the person's screen.
Start the Hermes gateway, as the Status tab's « Start » button does, and show that tab.
agentActions.details: Answers once the start is accepted; the gateway is up 10-20 s later (call status). A refusal (not installed, install running...) comes back as START_REFUSED with the host's reason.

agentActions.summary: Stop the gateway the cockpit started, as the Status tab's « Stop » button does.
agentActions.details: A gateway started elsewhere is not stopped from here (NOT_MANAGED).

agentActions.summary: Give Hermes a task, as the Tasks tab does, and show that tab. Hermes answers with its model, which costs credits or the person's own key.
agentActions.details: The gateway must be up. Any command Hermes wants to run waits for the person's approval on their screen. Follow the task with tasks.

task.description: What Hermes should do, in plain words.

agentActions.summary: Stop a running task, as its « Stop » button does.
